pass_rule.sentence: The candidate-list test fails on free data: the 43-variable score's top tenth, formed monthly and held to the last price, is +4.21 points a year against the average member after costs (Newey-West t 2.70; the rule needs more than 2 points and t above 3), and its paired difference against the 12-1 momentum top tenth is +2.71 points (t 1.15; the rule needs a positive difference with t above 2).

consequence: the candidate list stays out of the score (the proposal's fallback is the 50 largest members)
